title: Sephiria Builds (1.0) — Best Setups, Weapon Paths & Artifact Pairings
description: Sephiria builds guide: what a build actually is, seven community setups with their weapon paths, plus Artifact and Tablet pairing rules and version notes.
meta: Covers sephiria builds / best build / companion / planet-style queries at setup level.
body:
A Sephiria build is not a wish list — it is a commitment. Pick a combo family, feed it, and spend Tablets on the tags that actually carry the run.

What actually makes a build work

  • Force one or two combo families (Storm Cloud, Companion, Ember/Solar, Glacier, Magitech and similar) instead of collecting every tag you see.
  • Use Bond Artifacts to bridge two combos — you usually only need one side active before the bridge pays off.
  • Stack levels into a few carry Artifacts rather than spreading upgrades evenly.
  • Re-place the grid after every new Artifact or Tablet. Tablets reward geometry (lines, columns, crosses), so a good Artifact parked outside an active pattern is dead weight.
  • Pair the run with a costume. Skins change opening stats, so a low-input build and a high-APM build want different ones — see characters and costumes.

Build archetypes people actually clear with

These are community setups, not official loadouts, and the version notes below say when each was recorded.

SetupWeapon pathPlaystyleWhy it clears
Frozen SmeltDagger → Sleeping Frost → Frozen SmeltLow-input crowd controlFreezes normal enemies fast and forgives mistakes; community Hard 60 clear reported
Formless DanceStaff → Throwing Spear → Formless DanceRanged evasionHigh mobility plus ranged pressure; the evasion variant is the safer version
MinigunHeavy Crossbow → Unstable Lightning Mark → MinigunSustained ranged fireAutomatic fire while you reposition; recorded high-difficulty footage
Guardian GreatswordSteel Greatsword lineBeginner defenceShield plus lifesteal with low legendary dependence
Biryuu KatanaKatana → BiryuuAggressive meleeHighest melee ceiling once parry timing clicks
Creaking SpineSteel Greatsword → Bone Mechanism Sword → Creaking SpineHeavy meleeFewer, bigger hits that line up with boss windows
Infinite Elemental BoltStaff → Flame Staff → Elemental Fusion StaffCaster / rangedElemental amplification carries late floors; also reported as a floor-50 stopping point
Community sites spell the evolution names differently (Frozen Smelt, Creaking Spine, Biryuu, Ilonica and so on). Treat the path shape — branch, mid-step, endpoint — as the reliable part.

Artifact and Tablet pairings

Tablets are the multipliers; Artifacts are the payload. Match Tablet geometry to the family your build already leans on.

Build familyArtifacts to chaseSpend Tablets on
Freeze / Glacier (Dagger)Frost and Glacier tags, Ice Armament piecesFreeze uptime and elemental damage, not raw attack speed
Companion / summonerCompanion-family items (contracts, moles, jellyfish, cushions)Companion count and companion damage
Storm Cloud / MagitechStorm and lightning tags that keep hitting while you dodgeArea coverage and tick rate
Ranged (Crossbow)Reload and projectile-count piecesProjectile count and pierce
Tank / reflect (Sword and Shield)Block, reflect and lifesteal piecesDamage reduction and recovery

Community build reports also name specific must-have items per route (the freeze route lists an ice-themed trio, for example), but item names move between patches — confirm the item in your own client before rebuilding the whole grid around it.

Costumes and Talents

Two levers sit outside the grid. Costumes set your opening stats — see the costume roster for effects and unlocks. Talents come from the Destiny Inscription tree and can be respecced, so early picks are cheap to undo.

Version notes

The community build reports we cross-checked were recorded against 1.0.24-era and 1.0.x builds, with some marked for re-test on a later patch. Treat any preset or item list as a snapshot: the shape of the build ages better than the exact item names.
